worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.summary: Drive a Water Pledge into chosen ground: a pillar of water surges up, soaking everyone inside, pushing them back and up, and slowing them, then leaves a waterlogged pledge scar. If a fire or grass pledge scar already lies near the point, the vows answer: the strike is far heavier and raises a rainbow (water + fire) or sinks the ground into a wetland (water + grass).
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.descriptio: The pillar surges up at the chosen point and deals %1$s special damage to every enemy inside.
The column is %1$s blocks across and %2$s blocks tall.
Enemies inside are pushed %1$s blocks back and lifted at %2$s blocks per tick, and are soaked and slowed for %3$s.
The base leaves a waterlogged pledge scar, %1$s blocks across, lasting %2$s; enemies on it are continually slowed.

If a fire or grass pledge scar lies within %1$s blocks, the two vows resonate: this strike deals ×%2$s and raises a rainbow (water + fire, healing allies inside) or sinks the ground into a wetland (water + grass, which roots those who step in).
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.deluge.on: Deluge vow: power ×1.10, scar ×1.2, push ×1.25, range ×0.9, cooldown +12.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.timing: Cast range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.0: Raise a water pillar on distant ground and push foes back
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.1: Soak a patch of ground with a waterlogged pledge scar
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.use.2: Combine with a fire or grass pledge into a rainbow or a wetland
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.preference: On (deluge vow): power ×1.10, scar ×1.2, push ×1.25, but range ×0.9 and cooldown +12 — surges harder and wider, yet you must stand closer and recover slower. Off (calm flow): range ×1.1, cooldown −4, push ×0.9 — farther, faster, lighter push.
The companion only raises a water pillar while the threat is within this distance; beyond it, it closes in first.
worldcombat.skill.waterpledge.growth.0: From level %1$s the pillar gains another step with level (about %2$s).
